name: Mani, Inc.
summary: Mani, Inc. engages in the manufacture and supply of surgical and dental instruments in Japan, Asia, Europe, North America, and internationally. The company operates through three segments: Surgical Products, Eyeless Needle Products, and Dental Products. The company offers surgical instruments, such as maniplers, vessel knives, ENT knives, and stainless wire needles; and ophthalmic instruments, including ophthalmic sutures and knives, and trocar kits for vitrectomy.
